content.title: Microsoft to invest $17.5B in India, PNC to allow bitcoin trading
content.description:
Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Microsoft's (MSFT) plans to invest $17.5 billion in India over the next four years, Campbell's (CPB) reporting a decline in profit and revenue in its fiscal first quarter release, and PNC Financial Services Group (PNC) to allow bitcoin (BTC-USD) trading.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
